choices.why: A true 204 cm light grey three-seater with slim tapered arms and brass legs, modern and well sized for the long left wall.
This large 305x244 cream and soft grey rug anchors the seating area and keeps the room bright against the grey wood floor.
The only truly light wood option, in pale ash with tapered legs, giving a fresh Scandinavian touch that matches the brief.
Its white body blends with the walls, its walnut chevron doors add warmth, and its black legs echo the balcony window frames.
The brass stem and opal globe repeat the sofa's brass legs, and the black marble base ties in with the window frames.

A tall areca palm gives lush, airy green by the balcony door at the end of the sofa.
These soft white sheers filter the light from the sliding door while keeping the living room luminous.

answer.why: A light grey sofa, a cream rug, a pale ash table and white sheers keep the room bright and modern. Brass and black accents echo the window frames, and the teal and mustard cushions plus the palm add the requested color for entertaining friends.
